summary: The newest outages hit the NSA's internal network and Apple services on Nov 17. The NSA cited routine maintenance and Apple cited an internal update. The Director of National Intelligence says it is not a cyberattack or a coordinated nation-state effort. Stocks fell again, but futures rose after Nvidia's earnings.

events.title: NSA classified internal network (NSANet) reported down
events.impact: Six sources told CNN the NSA's internal communications network went down. How long it lasted and whether it is fixed are unknown. I saw no recovery report.
events.stated_cause: NSA pointed to scheduled routine maintenance. A source told the WSJ a system patch was under way. No official source reports a cyber attack.

events.title: FAA nationwide ground stop; router installs paused
events.impact: More than 12,000 flights were cancelled on Nov 13. The FAA paused Juniper router installs on Nov 17 and turned off the suspect function on about 60 similar routers.
events.stated_cause: FAA says a new router at El Dorado, Arkansas flooded other equipment with data. HPE says its gear worked as configured. Duffy says root cause is not yet clear. The FBI is helping check that no hack occurred.

events.title: Apple services (iCloud, Apple Pay, App Store, Support) outage
events.impact: Thousands of Downdetector reports for Apple Support, Apple Pay and iCloud. Apple said many systems were back up and running afterward.
events.stated_cause: Apple says an internal update caused the outage. Apple told Bloomberg it was not a cyberattack.

events.title: Chase banking services disrupted
events.impact: Chase customers could not use some services on Monday. Outage trackers showed other banks too, but reporting says the problem came from Chase. Chase now looks operational.
events.stated_cause: Chase says a software bug in an on-premise hardware system caused it, and it is not cyber-related.

events.title: Marriott sign-in outage on website and Bonvoy app
events.impact: Travelers could not sign in on Marriott.com and the Bonvoy app for a time. Marriott says it is fixed.
events.stated_cause: Marriott says it was a technical issue. Its review found no sign of a cyberattack.

events.title: United Airlines tech outage delays departures
events.impact: A technology outage delayed some United departures on Monday. United said it was resolved.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. United called it a technology issue. No official source links it to the FAA event.

events.title: Norway's Equinor reports a cyberattack on some IT systems
events.impact: Forbes says Equinor detected a cyberattack on certain IT systems. I saw no details on scope or effect on energy supply, and no second source.
events.stated_cause: Described as a cyberattack by the company, per Forbes. Who did it is unknown.

events.title: US stocks fall a fourth day; futures rebound after Nvidia
events.impact: The S&P 500 slid about 1% on Nov 17 to its lowest level since June. Futures rose Wednesday after Nvidia beat estimates. I saw no trading halts or exchange glitches.
events.stated_cause: Reports cite worry about AI stock values, rate fears and Nvidia's leadership change. Bloomberg also said tech outages added to unease.

events.title: Bitcoin about 12-13% lower on the week, near 64-65K USD
events.impact: Price data shows BTC near 64.6K, down about 12.6% over 7 days but almost flat over 24 hours. This is a gradual slide, not a crash. I found no exchange outage.
events.stated_cause: Not stated by price sources. One market note says traders are pricing in a possible Fed rate hike next month.

events.title: AT&T and Spectrum user complaints on outage trackers
events.impact: A few hundred Downdetector reports for AT&T, and mixed data for Spectrum. No carrier confirmation or wire-service report seen. Looks like normal background noise.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. No carrier has given a cause.

events.title: Cloudflare status shows degraded performance
events.impact: Cloudflare's status page lists Sites and Services as degraded performance as of 04:51 UTC. Such notices are frequent, so this is near normal.
events.stated_cause: No cause published on the status feed I saw.

events.title: Routine CISA notices on actively exploited flaws
events.impact: CISA keeps adding exploited bugs to its known-exploited list and posting routine advisories. I saw no new CISA Emergency Directive in the last 3 days.
events.stated_cause: Attackers exploiting software flaws. No notice links to the outages above.

connection_assessment.reasoning: The FAA says a new router flooded older gear with data. Apple says an internal update. Chase says a software bug. Marriott says a technical issue. The NSA points to routine maintenance. The Director of National Intelligence says it is not a cyberattack or a coordinated nation-state effort. No official source links them. The FAA's full root cause is still unknown.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same company or attacker, or several big systems failing at the same moment, would make me think they are connected.
